# ComplianceFinding

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

One reported accessibility/compliance issue, resolved to an element when applicable.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new ComplianceFinding()
```

## Properties

- [`Clause`](#clause): Clause citation within `Standard`, e.g. "ISO 14289-1:2014 §7.3".
- [`Code`](#code): Stable rule identifier, e.g. "figure-missing-alt".
- [`FixHint`](#fixhint): How to fix it, phrased as an authoring action.
- [`Message`](#message): Human-readable, author-facing description of the problem.
- [`NodeId`](#nodeid): The snapshot node this finding is anchored to; null for document-level findings.
- [`Page`](#page): 0-based page index of the element's first rectangle, for navigation.
- [`Role`](#role): The element's resolved role, when node-scoped.
- [`Severity`](#severity): How serious the finding is.
- [`Standard`](#standard): The standard the rule derives from: "PDF/UA-1" or "WCAG 2.2".
